facts.cupStatus: Melbourne Cup ballot exemption / Golden Ticket

verifiedEvidence.campaignContext: Ciaron Maher said the Cup had been a long-range plan, that Shockletz would run two miles, and after earning the ballot exemption her program could be worked back from the 3 November Melbourne Cup. He indicated she would not be over-raced and would be kept on the fresher side.
